title: Dataset
description: Definition of reusable test data, referenced by its file path instead of duplicating literal values across suites/scenarios. Supports two mutually exclusive uses: 'data' is a single named bag of values referenced from step params (e.g. {"$dataset": "test_user"}); 'rows' is a table used for data-driven iteration, referenced from a testcase's for_each so the testcase runs once per row. A dataset must define exactly one of 'data' or 'rows', never both there's no well-defined meaning for a dataset that's simultaneously a single bag and a table.

name.description: Optional human-readable display label for this dataset, shown in results/UI.

description.description: Optional free-text description of what this dataset represents.

data.description: A single bag of values, referenced whole or by field from a step's placeholders.

rows.description: Rows of values for data-driven iteration. A step/scenario call whose resolved dataset has 'rows' runs once per row, with each row's fields available for interpolation.

examples.name: test_user
examples.description: Default credentials used by the login scenario in most suites.

examples.name: seeded_users
examples.description: All users seeded in the staging environment, used to run login as each one.
